d: We are seeking a talented and motivated Architect to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be will be the point where three design elements (concept, elevation and detailing) come together. The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio, proficiency in design and BIM software (such as AutoCAD, Revit, and SketchUp), and a solid understanding of building codes and construction methods.
q: 5-8+ years of experience in construction and architecture
Experience on concept development, facade-driven or high-rise projects.
Strong organizational, creative and presentation skills
r: li
Develop concept options, massing studies / Zoning and 3D models from the team lead's direction.
li
Prepare dimensioned elevations, material tags and finish schedules.
li
Draft facade sections, wall sections, typical bay and junction details.
li
Issue drawing sets accurately and keep revisions under control.
li
Plan and track deadlines and deliverables across the three design aspects.
li
Review & further develop plans, sections, elevations and facade packages before issue.
li
Coordinate with structural, MEP and facade systems, to identify the clashes and further solutions.
li
Strong concept design and design development experience, including elevations.
li
Strong facade detailing knowledge: systems, materials, junctions, and working with facade consultants and suppliers.
li
Experience taking projects from concept to issued drawings and through delivery: tender, construction-stage queries and shop-drawing review.
li
Ability to review drawings for consistency and code compliance.

d: Design, build, and implement a scalable, secure, and highly available private cloud platform using VMware and Red Hat OpenShift (OCP). Ensure platform readiness, automation, enterprise integration, and compliance with security and governance standards.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in VMware infrastructure, private cloud architecture, and platform implementation.
Strong hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter, NSX-T, and vSAN.
Experience with Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, and container platforms.
Knowledge of vRA, vRO, vROps, Ansible, REST APIs, and ServiceNow.
Experience in cloud automation, DR, high availability, infrastructure security, and enterprise integrations.
Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
r: li
Design and implement end-to-end private cloud and container platform architectures (HLD/LLD).
li
Deploy and manage VMware infrastructure, including vSphere, vCenter, NSX-T, and vSAN.
li
Design, deploy, and manage Red Hat OpenShift (OCP) clusters and container platforms.
li
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise network, security, storage, and ITSM systems.
li
Implement disaster recovery (DR), replication, high availability, and backup strategies.
li
Configure VMware cloud management tools, including vRA, vRO, and vROps.
li
Develop automation workflows using Ansible, vRO, APIs, and scripting.
li
Enable self-service provisioning, service catalogs, templates, and blueprints through ServiceNow/vRA.
li
Implement multi-tenancy, RBAC, resource management, and cloud governance.
li
Ensure platform security, scalability, performance, and production readiness.
li
Prepare technical documentation, architecture designs, and operational procedures.

d: Empower Future Problem Solvers as Our Middle School Math Teacher

Are you a dedicated educator passionate about making numbers come alive and helping students build a strong foundation in mathematical reasoning? As a Middle School Math Teacher, you will guide students in developing critical thinking, logical analysis, and practical problem-solving skills through engaging, real-world learning experiences.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Education with a major in Mathematics, or a related field.
Proven experience teaching middle school mathematics or working in a similar educational role.
Strong communication, analytical, and classroom management skills.
If you are enthusiastic about inspiring young minds to embrace challenges, think critically, and discover the power of mathematics, we encourage you to apply
r: li
Design and deliver dynamic math lessons that introduce core concepts in pre-algebra, geometry, algebra, and number sense, fostering a deep understanding of mathematical principles.
li
Assess and evaluate student comprehension through formative checks, projects, quizzes, and unit exams, providing timely and constructive feedback to drive growth.
li
Cultivate an inclusive, encouraging, and dynamic classroom environment where students feel safe making mistakes, asking questions, and tackling complex numerical challenges.
li
Differentiate instruction and utilize a variety of teaching strategies to accommodate diverse learning styles and ensure every student reaches their full academic potential.
li
Partner with colleagues, administration, and parents to monitor academic progress, address individual learning needs, and celebrate student success.
